_comment: Controls the 3-touch cold outreach sequence. Edit freely, no code changes needed.
_from_email_note: Switch to your own verified domain in Resend once set up — a real domain sends far better than the shared onboarding address for cold outreach specifically.
_max_sends_note: Caps how many emails go out in a single run, per the brief's 15-25/day guidance. The daily schedule + this cap together control total volume.

touches.subject: Quick note about {business_name}'s website
touches.body:
Hi there,

I noticed {business_name}'s website {issue_line}. I put together a quick look at what it could look like fixed — attached below.

I run a small website studio here in State College. If a refresh would help, happy to send over a couple options — no pressure either way.

Best,
{sender_name}

touches.subject: Following up — {business_name}
touches.body:
Hi again,

Just following up on my note about {business_name}'s site. Totally understand if it's not a priority right now — if it ever is, I'm here.

Best,
{sender_name}

touches.subject: Last note — {business_name}
touches.body:
Hi one more time,

I'll leave this here as my last check-in for now. If a website refresh becomes useful down the line, feel free to reach out any time.

Best,
{sender_name}
